title: EtCBN-associated olfactory dysfunction involves Irf7 signaling and a microbiota-metabolite axis.
authors: Duan, Lianrui; Liang, Jiayi; Zhang, Wei; Liu, Ziyan; Kang, Huiwen; Huang, Danyang; Wang, Ziyan; Jiang, Guangyu; Gao, Ai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究环境污染物EtCBN通过Irf7信号及菌群-代谢物轴导致嗅觉功能障碍，仅用分子对接预测小分子与蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Liquid crystal monomers (LCMs) are emerging environmental contaminants with neurotoxic potential; however, their impact on olfactory function, a key early indicator of neurodegenerative diseases, is unknown. Here, we observed that exposure to LCM mixtures at an environmentally relevant dose (180 mug/kg) was associated with olfactory deficits in mice. Further investigation focused on a prevalent LCM monomer (EtCBN) found in indoor dust, a compound known to disrupt endothelial cell proliferation, as a key component of this effect. Mice exposed to environmentally relevant (20 mug/kg) or elevated (200 mug/kg) EtCBN for 12 weeks exhibited significant olfactory impairment, supported by behavioral deficits, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-based olfactory bulb atrophy, histopathological changes, and neuroinflammation. Molecular docking predicted that EtCBN may interact with Irf7 with a binding energy of -4.86 kcal/mol, suggesting a potential interaction that could serve as a candidate molecular initiating event (MIE). This interaction was associated with elevated IL-1beta and TNF-alpha levels and may be linked to the onset of neuroinflammation. In addition, a reduced abundance of Dubosiella was found to correlate with phenylalanine accumulation, potentially further contributing to Irf7 activation through a microbiota-metabolite-inflammation axis. Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) and probiotic supplementation provided evidence suggesting a role for the intestinal microbiota. Exogenous nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD(+)) was observed to be associated with mitigation of these effects. Together, these findings are consistent with a proposed adverse outcome pathway (AOP) framework that suggests a link between the EtCBN-Irf7 interaction and LCM-associated neurotoxicity, offering potential mechanistic insights and therapeutic targets for olfactory dysfunction.
abstract_zh: 液晶单体（LCMs）是新兴的环境污染物，具有神经毒性潜力；然而，它们对嗅觉功能（神经退行性疾病的关键早期指标）的影响尚不明确。在此，我们观察到，暴露于环境相关剂量（180微克/千克）的LCM混合物与小鼠嗅觉缺陷相关。进一步研究聚焦于室内灰尘中普遍存在的LCM单体（EtCBN），一种已知会干扰内皮细胞增殖的化合物，作为该效应的关键组成部分。暴露于环境相关剂量（20微克/千克）或升高剂量（200微克/千克）的EtCBN 12周的小鼠表现出显著的嗅觉损伤，这由行为缺陷、基于磁共振成像（MRI）的嗅球萎缩、组织病理学变化和神经炎症所支持。分子对接预测EtCBN可能与Irf7相互作用，结合能为-4.86千卡/摩尔，提示这种潜在相互作用可能作为候选分子起始事件（MIE）。这种相互作用与IL-1β和TNF-α水平升高相关，并可能与神经炎症的发作有关。此外，Dubosiella丰度降低被发现与苯丙氨酸积累相关，可能通过微生物群-代谢物-炎症轴进一步促进Irf7激活。粪便微生物群移植（FMT）和益生菌补充提供了暗示肠道微生物群作用的证据。外源性烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD(+)）被观察到与这些效应的缓解相关。综合来看，这些发现与提出的不良结局通路（AOP）框架一致，该框架暗示EtCBN-Irf7相互作用与LCM相关神经毒性之间存在联系，为嗅觉功能障碍提供了潜在的机制见解和治疗靶点。
